name: docker-project-restart-namespace
title: 修复 Docker Desktop 项目级重启网络命名空间失效
description: Docker Desktop Restart project 并行重启 Compose 项目时，network_mode service:app|worker 的 sidecar 引用失效 owner container ID，报 joining network namespace: No such container；要求项目级重启可收敛且保留 loopback/security 边界。
creator: lizhi
